# Member Number

## Summary
The identifier a membership program prints on the card — stable,
human-readable, quoted over the phone. Shared-realm block at
`member-number-field.gts`. It is a label, not a key: the card's id is what
other cards link by; the member number is what the member sees. Renders
monospaced so digit groups line up in lists.

## API
- `MemberNumberField` (default export) — StringField subclass with mono embedded/atom formats
- `formatMemberNumber(prefix, year, sequence, width = 8)` — the common `PREFIX-YYYY-SEQUENCE` shape

## Usage
```ts
import MemberNumberField from '../member-number-field';

@field memberNumber = contains(MemberNumberField);
```

## Example
Serializes as a plain string, so `containedExamples` cannot hold one — the
linked Loyalty Account carries `NBF-2019-00004821` in use.

## Non-goals
Sequencing is the enrolling command's problem: a realm has no global
counter, so where the next number comes from (a count query, an imported
roll, a random block) is decided there — this block only formats and
renders consistently. Uniqueness is likewise not enforced here.
